name: Eight-Legged Menaces
summary: In Duskwood, venom web spiders crowd the western border. Watcher Dodds calls on travelers to thin their numbers before more Night Watch guards are caught in their webs.

sections.title: A Border Under Siege
sections.body: Pygmy venom web spiders swarm the brush along the western road from Westfall into Duskwood. Their webs choke the thickets beneath the dense canopy, putting travelers and the Night Watch's fragile defenses at risk.

sections.title: The Burden on the Night Watch
sections.body: Watcher Dodds keeps a small camp far from Darkshire, with too few troops to hold the border. Commander Althea Ebonlocke cannot send reinforcements while undead and worgen press against the township. Dodds has already lost comrades to the spiders, finding them hanging upside down in the canopy as venom paralyzed them and liquefied their flesh.

faq.answer: Watcher Dodds, a Night Watch member at a small camp in Duskwood, asks travelers to clear out the spiders.

faq.q: Why can't the Night Watch handle the spiders themselves?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke keeps her small garrison near Darkshire to repel relentless undead assaults. Dodds has too few troops to attack the border nests and still hold his post.
Pygmy venom web spiders swarm in Duskwood's western woods, in brush just off the main road from Westfall.

faq.q: What makes these spiders so dangerous to the watch?
faq.answer: The spiders are numerous, and their venom paralyzes and dissolves flesh. Night Watchmen caught in their webs hang helpless in the boughs, easy prey.

faq.q: Are these the only spiders in Duskwood?
faq.answer: No. Pygmy venom web spiders are the smaller broodlings. Much larger and deadlier spiders live deeper in the woods and threaten travelers.

faq.q: Why has the insect and spider population grown so aggressively?
faq.answer: Magical corruption blankets Duskwood and has twisted its native wildlife, making the creatures more aggressive, larger, and deadlier.

angles.text: The Night Watch receives no aid from the House of Nobles, so support from Alliance travelers helps keep the roads open.
As a Hunter, you face vicious venom web spiders in Duskwood; careful footwork and anti-venom preparation help you hunt them.
